name: Happy Path — GDPR SAR Submission and Response
description: Customer submits SAR digitally. Identity verified via SCA. Automated data extraction from all source systems. DPO review and redaction. Encrypted response delivered via secure link within 30 days.

steps.action: Submit SAR via online banking portal + complete SCA
POST /sca/validate {assertion}
200 OK {valid: true}
POST /sar {sca_assertion_ref}
Create SarCase (ENT-072) status=received; set deadline_date = today + 30 days
Publish SarCaseOpened (EVT-159)
Consume EVT-159 → Send acknowledgement: case ref, 30-day deadline
Consume EVT-159 → Write immutable SAR receipt record
201 Created {sar_case_id, deadline_date}
Display SAR confirmation: case reference, 30-day deadline
Consume EVT-159 → Extract KYC/AML records for customer_id (intra-CAP-005)
Return KYC data extract (intra-capability direct call)
Consume EVT-159 → Extract account data and transaction history for customer_id
Publish SarDataExtractReady (internal event) → SVC-015 receives data extract
Compile full data pack; update SarCase status=under_review
DPO review; apply Schedule 2 exemptions; redact third-party data; generate encrypted PDF
Update SarCase status=response_ready; generate secure download link (14-day expiry)
Publish SarCaseClosed (EVT-160) {dispatched_at, days_to_close, response_download_link}
Consume EVT-160 → Make download link available in customer portal
Consume EVT-160 → Send response ready notification with secure download link
Consume EVT-160 → Write immutable closure record with days_to_close
Download encrypted response pack via secure link
Deliver encrypted PDF response pack (within 30-day deadline)
